title: King Hezekiah's Prayer and the Fall of Sennacherib
description: King Hezekiah receives a threatening letter from the Assyrian king Sennacherib and brings it before the Lord in the temple. The prophet Isaiah delivers God's answer, and the angel of the Lord strikes down 185,000 men in the Assyrian camp. Sennacherib returns home to Nineveh and is killed by his own sons.

versions.title: King Hezekiah's Prayer
versions.description: King Hezekiah prays to God when the Assyrian army threatens Jerusalem. An angel strikes down the enemy.
